findings: ZIP 38677 (University) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 38677 (University) has 10 organizations listing opportunities online, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.
